# Introduction
This manual describes all of the primary analytics methods part of the driveanalytics package.
These methods were originally designed to work with the PICTURE cohort analytics platform but they can be used in either standalone R projects or shiny dashboards.

Each of these methods is designed to work with the GOSH/DRIVE standardised data model, RDVs; however, they could work with other data models, such as OMOP.
